title: Certificate Start date + term = End date, same day, clamped
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. These are number and date accuracy cases: enter the exact inputs, read the value the screen shows, and compare it with the value worked out below.
  3. An asset with a compliance service "CVIP" (asset card Compliance section > + Add record opens the record form). Cancel each form after reading it.
custom_steps:
1. Term 12 months, Start date 14 Oct 2025: read End date.
  2. Term 1 month, Start date 31 Jan 2026: read End date. Then Start date 31 Jan 2028: read End date.
  3. Term 3 months, Start date 30 Nov 2026: read End date.
  4. Term 1 month, End date 31 Mar 2027 (Start empty): read Start date.
  5. Term 12 months, Start date 14 Oct 2025; then change the Term to 6 months: read End date. Then type End date 1 Mar 2026 yourself and change the Term to 12 months: read both dates.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • 14 Oct 2026 (same day number, 12 months on).
  • 28 Feb 2026 (31 Feb does not exist, so the last day of February); 29 Feb 2028 in the leap year.
  • 28 Feb 2027 (30 Feb does not exist).
  • 28 Feb 2027 (31 Mar − 1 month: 31 Feb does not exist, so the last day of February; the rule holds both ways).
  • Changing the Term re-works the untouched End date to 14 Apr 2026; once End date is typed too (1 Mar 2026), changing the Term leaves both typed dates as they are.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10565 (S8, Compliance inspection records on the asset), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S8 (Term and the two dates; S8-R10); Plan 1 — Track, act, clear — Technical Implementation Plan, section 6 Phase P2, frontend tests (certificateDates); section 1 Product answers index, Q15; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R10: “End date lands on the same day number: 14 Oct 2025 plus 12 months is 14 Oct 2026”
  • S8-R10: “Where that day does not exist in the end month, it is the last day of that month, so 31 Jan plus 1 month is the last day of February”
  • Plan 1 §6 P2 certificateDates tests: “31 Jan 2026 + 1 → 28 Feb 2026; 31 Jan 2028 + 1 → 29 Feb 2028; 30 Nov + 3 → 28 Feb (non-leap) (clamp)”
  • Plan 1 §1 Q15: “Certificate End = Start + term, same day number, clamped to month end both ways”
  • Plan 1 §6 P2 certificateDates tests: “a changed term re-derives only the untouched date”
